host_storage_capacity: for each 4-GPU node: 14 TB NVMe RAID10 local (8x 3577 GiB raw)
host_networking: 4x 400 Gb/s NVIDIA ConnectX-7 InfiniBand NDR ports per node (1 per GPU), connected to an InfiniBand NDR leaf/spine fabric with one leaf switch per rail
host_networking_topology: 4-rail InfiniBand NDR fat-tree (each node port on its own leaf)
host_network_card_count: for each 4-GPU node: 4x NVIDIA ConnectX-7 400G InfiniBand (compute fabric), 1x NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU (100 GbE)
hw_notes: GB200 NVL72; 64 nodes x 4 GPU = 256 GPU, 16 nodes in each of 4 NVL72 racks.
sw_notes: deepseekv3_671b-arm:20261006, config_GB200_64x4x480xtp2pp4ep32cp1_mxfp8_full_cg.sh (MXFP8 GEMM, BF16 attention with FP8_DPA=False, TP 2, PP 4, EP 32, GBS 15360, full-iteration CUDA graphs), launched with dsv3-64n.sh. cuDNN RMSNorm + MXFP8 quantize fusion in both directions with NVTE_CUDNN_MXFP8_NORM_OUTPUT_IN_INPUT_DTYPE=0.
